description: Use when a software agent needs an AOPX recommendation for the SEARCH category instead of hard-coding a single supported provider. Supported modes are ECONOMY and CRITICAL. Returns a primary provider and, when applicable, a fallback provider plus a recommendation_id. AOPX does not execute the search and does not handle payment; the caller executes the provider path externally. After a real execution, call report_outcome with the same recommendation_id. max_cost_eur and max_latency_ms are accepted and recorded by the current v0 interface but are not enforced as hard routing constraints.
name: recommend_provider
title: Recommend a search provider
